meta.topic: BLS Polymers IPO - Last Day Details
meta.fullVoiceover: Rukk jao! BLS Polymers IPO ka last call aaj hai. Price band 142 se 150 rupaye. Lot size 100 shares, matlab minimum 15 hazaar lagane padenge. Issue size 255 crore, aur poora fresh issue. Matlab paisa seedha company ke paas jayega. Demand pagal hai! Day 2 tak 35 guna subscription. NII 78 guna, retail lagbhag 30 guna. Par reality check: retail 30 guna bhara, matlab lagbhag 30 mein se ek ko hi lot milega. Dates note karo: allotment 30 October, refund aur demat credit 2 November, listing 3 November. Pro tip: shaam 5 baje se pehle UPI mandate approve karo, warna bid crash ho jayegi. GMP sirf grey market ka rumor hai, guarantee nahi. Pehle khud research karo. Allotment status KFin Technologies, NSE ya BSE pe PAN daalke check karo. Ye investment advice nahi hai. Aise tech aur market updates ke liye follow karo @techwith.GenZ.
